name: progress-crabs
description: Band above the prompt with a live progress bar of the chat's task list and what Claude is doing, plus a Crab Tasks pane: a bar per step and side sessions as animated crabs. Themeable: Dracula, Tokyo Night, Nord, GitHub, Gruvbox, One Dark, Catppuccin.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colour theme for the band and crab cards. /progress theme <name> overrides it.

done_color.title: Done colour
done_color.description: Finished steps. Hex like #bd93f9; blank keeps the theme's colour.

current_color.title: Current colour
current_color.description: The running step and "thinking". Hex like #bd93f9; blank keeps the theme's colour.

next_color.title: Next colour
next_color.description: The step up next and "running". Hex like #bd93f9; blank keeps the theme's colour.

crab_color.title: Crab colour
crab_color.description: The crabs' shells. Hex like #bd93f9; blank keeps the theme's colour.
